# 🚀 Blogspot / Blogger Par 2 Minute Me Legal Pages Publish Karne Ka Guide

Aap **Google Blogger / Blogspot** (100% Free & Lifetime Permanent) par direct in pages ko host kar sakte hain. Google Play Console Blogspot ke links ko **100% Accept & Approve** karta hai!

---

## 📌 Step-by-Step Instructions:

### Step 1: Blogger Open Karein
1. [Blogger.com](https://www.blogger.com) open karein.
2. Apne Google Account se login karke **"New Blog"** banayein (e.g. `sscenglishpro-policy.blogspot.com`).

---

### Step 2: Pages Banayein (पेज सेक्शन me jayein)
Left menu me **Pages (पेज)** par click karein -> **+ New Page (नया पेज)** par tap karein:

#### Page 1: Privacy Policy
* **Title**: `Privacy Policy`
* **Editor Mode**: Pencil icon par click karke **`< > HTML View`** select karein.
* **Content**: [privacy.html](file:///d:/main%20app/public/privacy.html) ka poora code copy karke paste kar dein.
* **Publish** par click karein.
* 🔗 **Google Play Console Link**: `https://sscenglishpro-policy.blogspot.com/p/privacy-policy.html`

---

#### Page 2: Terms & Conditions
* **Title**: `Terms and Conditions`
* **HTML View**: [terms.html](file:///d:/main%20app/public/terms.html) ka code paste karein.
* **Publish** par click karein.

---

#### Page 3: Data Deletion Request (Google Play Mandatory)
* **Title**: `Data & Account Deletion`
* **HTML View**: [data-deletion.html](file:///d:/main%20app/public/data-deletion.html) ka code paste karein.
* **Publish** par click karein.

---

#### Page 4: Refund Policy
* **Title**: `Refund and Cancellation Policy`
* **HTML View**: [refund.html](file:///d:/main%20app/public/refund.html) ka code paste karein.
* **Publish** par click karein.

---

#### Page 5: Contact Us & Support
* **Title**: `Contact Us & Support`
* **HTML View**: [contact.html](file:///d:/main%20app/public/contact.html) ka code paste karein.
* **Publish** par click karein.

---
